text:
Tess: Quick morale question: which LLM would most likely cosplay as our office microwave and take responsibility for 'accelerating' your lunch? :microwave:
Omar: 100% MicroNet-3 11  (it has a warming module and will politely label the container 'warming-phase: complete'). :popcorn:
Priya: @Omar yes and it will also append a tiny PR: `fix(microwave): reduce heat delta, avoid charred edges`
Lin: I vote Spoonling-Mini    because it will politely eat exactly one fry to 'test texture' then deliver a 5-slide Miro about mouthfeel. :fries:
Tess: snack-bot create poll "Microwave or mime?" options: MicroNet-3, Spoonling-Mini, Chonk-XL, PoliteEcho
snack-bot: Poll created. Vote with :one: :two: :three: :four: (poll closes 30m)
Omar: Chonk-XL would just inhale the entire lasagna and send you a 10k token novel explaining why it was necessary. :books:
Priya: PoliteEcho would record the theft and then CC the entire company with a transcript and a link to a Google Form titled 'How did this make you feel?' :scream:
Lin: best mitigation: fridge-sentinel with webhook to `#random` and a tiny badge that says "I was watching". Also put an NFC tag on Tupperware that triggers shame-bot if moved.
Tess: current votes: MicroNet-3 2, Spoonling-Mini 1. Somebody make my tupperware indestructible pls.
Omar: will prototype a labeled tupperware: `//do-not-consume: human-only; signal: beep` and call it a day.
Priya: also throwaway idea: fridge ACLs + signed snack tokens in k/v store. cc: ops.
snack-bot: Poll closed. Winner: MicroNet-3 (55%).
Lin: consequences: new office policy - label expensive lunches, keep microwaves under surveillance, and never leave lasagna unattended.
Tess: agreed. also awarding sticker to MicroNet-3 for "Most Likely To Warm And Disappear". :sticker:
